title: The Patient Visitor
author: I. M. Eriksen
blurb: Ivo Montrose, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
